name: Lens & Ledger pre-registration v1, addendum 2: contest misread guard
why: The first full dry run (no submissions) showed the AI misreading a Central Pacific hurricane-names question (97% on names the market priced at 1-2.5%).

rule.settled_outcomes: market exactly 0 or 1 (known result): AI ignored
rule.misread: live market and |AI - market| > 0.5: AI view dropped for that outcome; in one-winner sets the whole question's AI view is dropped; no rationale published
